name: The Example
_comment: A fixture, not a place worth visiting. It exists to use every shape and several materials, so that a shape this schema accepts and the renderer does not implement fails a test rather than producing an invisible landmark. Both the Python and the JavaScript test suites read this file.
atmosphere: A plain worked over by someone testing what a world can contain.

ground.description: short dry grass over packed earth

features.description: a shallow pond, cold and clear to the bottom
a squared block of grey stone, waist high
a weathered wooden post, taller than a person
a low grassy bank you can walk up

license.notice: Numbers written for this project. No third-party asset is involved, which is the point of a parametric world pack: there is nothing here to have provenance.
